package resolvers

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"FIXTURE_MODEL"
	"github.com/goliatone/go-crud/gql/helpers"
	_ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/uptrace/bun"
	"github.com/uptrace/bun/dialect/sqlitedialect"
)

type actorKey struct{}
type denyKey struct{}
type runtimeBus struct {
	stream           chan EventMessage
	calls            int
	err              error
	panicOnSubscribe bool
}

func (b *runtimeBus) Publish(context.Context, string, any) error { return nil }
func (b *runtimeBus) Subscribe(context.Context, string) (<-chan EventMessage, error) {
	b.calls++
	if b.panicOnSubscribe {
		panic("bus panic")
	}
	return b.stream, b.err
}
func closeScope(t *testing.T, s *helpers.SubscriptionScope) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	require.NoError(t, s.Close(ctx))
}

func TestBlockedGeneratedDeliveryJoins(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		payload any
		list    bool
	}{
		{"pointer", &model.Post{Title: "one"}, false}, {"value", model.Post{Title: "one"}, false},
		{"list-pointer", []*model.Post{{Title: "one"}}, true}, {"list-value", []model.Post{{Title: "one"}}, true},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, scope := helpers.WithSubscriptionScope(context.WithValue(t.Context(), actorKey{}, true))
			bus := &runtimeBus{stream: make(chan EventMessage)}
			r := &Resolver{Events: bus}
			var closed func()
			if tc.list {
				out, err := r.PostBatch(ctx)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				closed = func() {
					select {
					case _, ok := <-out:
						require.False(t, ok)
					case <-time.After(time.Second):
						t.Fatal("output stayed open after owner close")
					}
				}
			} else {
				out, err := r.PostCreated(ctx)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				closed = func() {
					select {
					case _, ok := <-out:
						require.False(t, ok)
					case <-time.After(time.Second):
						t.Fatal("output stayed open after owner close")
					}
				}
			}
			select {
			case bus.stream <- EventMessage{Payload: tc.payload}:
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
				t.Fatal("forwarder did not accept event")
			}
			// No output receiver exists. Close must cancel a pending send and join it.
			closeScope(t, scope)
			closed()
			_, err := r.PostCreated(ctx)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, helpers.ErrSubscriptionScopeClosed)
			require.Equal(t, 1, bus.calls)
		})
	}
}

func TestGeneratedAdmissionAndEarlyExit(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"anonymous", "overlay-scope", "resolver-scope", "canceled", "bus-error", "bus-panic", "no-bus", "closed-stream"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			parent := context.WithValue(t.Context(), actorKey{}, true)
			if mode == "anonymous" {
				parent = t.Context()
			}
			if mode == "overlay-scope" {
				parent = context.WithValue(parent, denyKey{}, true)
			}
			ctx, scope := helpers.WithSubscriptionScope(parent)
			bus := &runtimeBus{stream: make(chan EventMessage)}
			r := &Resolver{Events: bus}
			switch mode {
			case "resolver-scope":
				r.ScopeGuard = func(_ context.Context, entity, action string) error {
					require.Equal(t, "Post", entity)
					require.Equal(t, "subscribe", action)
					return errors.New("denied")
				}
			case "canceled":
				cancelCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
				cancel()
				ctx = cancelCtx
			case "bus-error":
				bus.err = errors.New("bus unavailable")
			case "bus-panic":
				bus.panicOnSubscribe = true
			case "no-bus":
				r.Events = nil
			case "closed-stream":
				close(bus.stream)
			}
			if mode == "bus-panic" {
				require.Panics(t, func() { _, _ = r.PostCreated(ctx) })
			} else {
				out, err := r.PostCreated(ctx)
				if mode == "closed-stream" {
					require.NoError(t, err)
					select {
					case _, ok := <-out:
						require.False(t, ok)
					case <-time.After(time.Second):
						t.Fatal("closed bus did not close output")
					}
				} else {
					require.Error(t, err)
					require.Nil(t, out)
				}
			}
			closeScope(t, scope)
			if mode == "anonymous" || mode == "overlay-scope" || mode == "resolver-scope" || mode == "canceled" || mode == "no-bus" {
				require.Zero(t, bus.calls)
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, 1, bus.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGeneratedNormalDeliveryAndUnscopedCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.WithValue(t.Context(), actorKey{}, true))
	defer cancel()
	bus := &runtimeBus{stream: make(chan EventMessage, 3)}
	r := &Resolver{Events: bus}
	out, err := r.PostCreated(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	bus.stream <- EventMessage{Err: errors.New("ignored")}
	bus.stream <- EventMessage{Payload: 42}
	bus.stream <- EventMessage{Payload: model.Post{Title: "kept"}}
	select {
	case got := <-out:
		require.Equal(t, "kept", got.Title)
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("valid payload not forwarded")
	}
	cancel()
	select {
	case _, ok := <-out:
		require.False(t, ok)
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("unscoped cancellation did not close output")
	}
}

type authorRow struct {
	bun.BaseModel `bun:"table:authors,alias:author"`
	ID            string `bun:"id,pk"`
}
type postRow struct {
	bun.BaseModel `bun:"table:posts,alias:post"`
	ID            string `bun:"id,pk"`
	Title         string
	AuthorID      string
	Author        *authorRow `bun:"rel:belongs-to,join:author_id=id"`
}

func TestGeneratedScalarAndNestedCriteria(t *testing.T) {
	sqlDB, err := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	sqlDB.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	db := bun.NewDB(sqlDB, sqlitedialect.New())
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, db.Close()) })
	for _, query := range []string{"CREATE TABLE authors (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)", "CREATE TABLE posts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, author_id TEXT)", "INSERT INTO authors VALUES ('a')", "INSERT INTO posts VALUES ('1','Alpha','a'),('2','Beta','a'),('3','Gamma','a')"} {
		_, err := db.ExecContext(t.Context(), query)
		require.NoError(t, err)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		filters []*model.FilterInput
		want    string
	}{
		{"scalar-in", []*model.FilterInput{{Field: "title", Operator: model.FilterOperatorIN, Value: "Alpha,Beta"}}, "Beta"},
		{"scalar-eq", []*model.FilterInput{{Field: "title", Operator: model.FilterOperatorEQ, Value: "Beta"}}, "Beta"},
		{"nested", []*model.FilterInput{{Field: "author.id", Operator: model.FilterOperatorEQ, Value: "a"}}, "Gamma"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var rows []postRow
			limit := 1
			desc := model.OrderDirectionDESC
			query := db.NewSelect().Model(&rows)
			for _, criterion := range buildCriteria("Post", &model.PaginationInput{Limit: &limit}, []*model.OrderByInput{{Field: "title", Direction: &desc}}, tc.filters) {
				query = criterion(query)
			}
			require.NoError(t, query.Scan(t.Context()))
			require.Len(t, rows, 1)
			require.Equal(t, tc.want, rows[0].Title)
		})
	}
}
